text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*, *gasp*—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Even though my stamina has increased! 
Even though I had my body trained up!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(It's way harder to run than in the 
'Kikuka Sho'! —Harder for *me* to run!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(To be able to set a pace that matches an 
Umamusume like that...—!)

After the finish line. I rush over to her 
side with the team doctor as she breathes 
heavily.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... wheeze... I'm fine. There's... no 
pain...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—If you could just run freely like that, 
it'd really mess up the race pace I 
planned out.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Sei-chan—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't get the result I want. All 
I can do is play to my strengths, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye, Tsuru-chan. See you next time~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Wait up.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Sei-chan, you're strong. You have the 
mind to devise tactics, and the guts and 
stamina to execute them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I truly respect her. She's such an 
incredible Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I always thought so. I've been watching 
you all through the window this whole 
time.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My desire to win wasn't a lie. It wasn't 
a lie, but...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...It was almost like admiration.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Even as I felt envious... a part of me 
was looking up to her in sheer awe.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Even though we're the same age, in the 
same academy... you girls are achieving so 
much more than me. And you have twice as 
much motivation and ambition.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...I could only respect them. I thought 
it was only natural for them to be 
praised.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I could find any number of reasons why I 
couldn't win. I could see plenty of parts 
of myself that fell short.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still... I'm your rival!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even if you think 'who does she think she 
is?!' Even if you laugh at me for not 
knowing my place! —I'm still declaring 
that I'm going to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because I am "definitely" stronger than 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I don't need reasons to lose! I run 
believing only in my chance of beating 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've got confidence! I've got guts! And 
I've got pride in myself that won't lose 
to you, either!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because it's you—that's why I want to 
win!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, if there's a next time, I'll 
be the one to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...That's unfair.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Can you really blame me? My only weapon is 
a brain for concocting schemes. How I 
formulate tactics is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am not speaking of matters during the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So your fighting spirit was firmly 
directed at Lady Tsuru-chan as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...My eyes have been on you the entire 
time. Though my prediction on when you 
would blossom was a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We're in the same class, debuted the same 
year. And yet, I've never seen a single 
day where she didn't work hard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My peers are terrifying, you know. Every 
single one of them is an Umamusume 
overflowing with talent.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... ...*gasp*â

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Tsuru-chan, that was amazing! Even though 
today was tougher than the Kikuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Because you tried your hardest, I had a 
lot of fun running together!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
............If only I could say it like 
before. ...All I have to do is go and tell 
them, yet...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ......There's something wrong with me――

After the race. While tending to Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi, she quietly muttered to herself.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I want to run in the Takarazuka Kinen.

The Takarazuka Kinen is the Spring Grand 
Prix. A medium-distance GⅠ on the Senior 
royal road, gathering the most popular and 
celebrated Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My classmates are all superstars, so 
they're bound to gather there.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
As your personal physician, I have no 
objections either~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
You understand too, don't you, Trainer? 
Even after the Tenno Sho (Spring), the 
longest-distance GⅠ... she is still 
standing on both legs.
choice_data_list:
Yes, I was able to watch with much more 
peace of mind than ever before.

text_block_list.text:
Her body is different from last year. It 
has become a body capable of marching 
toward major goals, just like today.
choice_data_list: Let's go, Tsuyoshi. To defeat your rival.

Let's go, Tsuyoshi. To take down your 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...The winner of the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
has been decided, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Grass-san. Is it alright for you to be 
standing up already?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you for your trouble~

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's good. And her next race was 
the Yasuda Kinen, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Yasuda Kinen, and then straight 
to the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? The Takarazuka Kinen too...? There's 
barely any time between those GⅠ races, 
you know!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Now that the opportunity has presented 
itself, I cannot let it go to waste. I 
want to race as well... with them."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As a version of myself that has been 
honed, polished, and sharpened.

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's next goal is the 
Takarazuka Kinen. The spring Grand Prix 
where she'll compete against the stars.
